input.explanation: The whole fault is inside this repository. In src/io_shop/spend_summary.py, `average_spend_per_item_this_month` divided by the number of purchases made this month, and that number is zero for any shopper who hasn't bought anything this month. With the patch it returns 0 for that case. The flag only decides which code path a request takes, so nothing about the flag service or any other outside system has to change. With the patch deployed, monthly-spend-feature can be switched back on without those requests failing.
